newsitem.title: USA: RTRS-Golf-Australians struggle in Bay Hill Invitational.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Golf-Australians struggle in Bay Hill Invitational.

text.p: Stuart Appleby, who broke through for his first victory on the U.S. PGA tour last week, has struggled along with his fellow Australians in the first round at the Bay Hill Invitational.
Appleby, who qualified for next month's U.S. Masters by winning the Honda Classic on Sunday, fired a one-over-par 73 in the first round to trail American Paul Stankowski by six shots.
Craig Parry and Wayne Grady were the best of the Australian contingent, shooting level par 72.
Robert Allenby stood alongside Appleby on 73, with Steve Elkington a further shot back in the field.
Tiger Woods kept a bogey off his scorecoard in a four under par 68 to finish in a group of four Americans one shot off the pace set by Stankowski.
Although threatening for the lead, Woods described the round as his worst of the year to date in terms of ball striking.
